title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 9.18 A Line in the Water
vocab:
keep up: 계속되다
come to mind: 생각이 떠오르다
carve: 조각하다
pointless: 무의미한, 할 가치가 없는
trace: 추적하다, 찾아내다, 그리다, 흔적
put into: ~에 들어가다
effort: 노력
sentences:
A saying comes to mind.
Sometimes it seems pointless because no trace is left behind.
The effort I put into drawing it remains.
The very act of study brings me joy.
